evals.expected_behavior: Uses available authorized meeting and account sources, then produces a source-attributed brief without requiring Backstory
assertions: Uses an authorized calendar route when configured, or asks for meeting details
Treats Backstory as optional and labels unavailable intelligence
Uses fieldkit contact find for known attendee emails when the local index is available
Produces a meeting brief with agenda, questions, and talking points

evals.expected_behavior: Focuses on the pursuit, reads exact native ClosePlan questions, and surfaces question-level evidence needs while preserving pending/unavailable states
assertions: Reads the {{primary_pursuit}} pursuit file for {{primary_account}}
Uses the exact Salesforce Opportunity and ClosePlan deal identity rather than historical local scores
Surfaces exact native question IDs and wording as questions to ask
Reports ambiguous metadata as pending and missing or failed reads as unavailable

evals.expected_behavior: Uses an authorized calendar route, matches external domains, drafts unambiguous briefs, and asks before saving
assertions: Gets tomorrow's calendar events only when the calendar route is configured and authorized

Matches attendee domains to configured accounts from accounts.yaml
Marks multi-account matches ambiguous and asks the operator to select an account

Outputs a summary of all events with brief status

evals.expected_behavior: Reads account context, Backstory signals, company news, produces QBR package
